facts.text: Through the Pell Promise, William & Mary covers full tuition and fees for eligible in-state undergraduates who qualify for a Federal Pell Grant and demonstrate significant financial need.

sources.title: Pell Grant Guarantee | Undergraduate Admission | William & Mary
sources.quote: Through the Pell Promise, eligible in-state undergraduate students who qualify for a Federal Pell Grant and demonstrate significant financial need* will receive scholarship aid covering at least the full cost of tuition and fees.
